title: Consolidate the manifest/binding resolution rule into one helper
description: The rule that a checkout manifest project and vault binding must agree — project_not_registered when either is missing, binding_conflict when they differ — now exists as four private copies: boundProjectId in application/run.ts, boundProject in application/secrets.ts, the same checks twice in application/profiles.ts, and boundProject in application/audit.ts (added by WCLI-11). Each is identical in effect, so a change to the rule has four places to land and three chances to be missed. WCLI-11 declined to consolidate inside its own change because that would touch the run path a reviewer must re-verify, and filed this instead. One site is not the same call: profiles.ts also re-checks the binding inside a mutation transaction against an already-resolved projectId rather than against the manifest, so it needs its own reading before it moves.

acceptanceCriteria.text: One exported helper states the rule and its two error codes, and run.ts, secrets.ts, profiles.ts and audit.ts call it with no private copy left behind.
The consolidation is behaviour-preserving: the existing tests that assert project_not_registered and binding_conflict stay green, and each call site is read back from those tests rather than assumed.
